old_value: {"id":"mimid-1wgh.87","title":"Decision: one-to-one rooms are ordinary unnamed rooms of two, flagged direct locally; not room-policy-04 fixed_membership (agent choice, epic mimid-qqtk)","description":"Mark S2 (client-survey.md §10): a store-level direct flag. room-policy-04 §5 names fixed_membership rooms as the DM style (participants set at creation, no canAddParticipant on non-zero roles, ordinary users cannot leave, one such room per set of participants). Not used: mimid hosts a room then invites (participants are not set at creation), agent-frontends.md §7.1 makes PART a real leave, and the hub would need the uniqueness rule. Chosen: Store::open_direct hosts an unnamed room (HostOptions::named(\"\"), default policy) and invites the user; the direct flag is local and never sent, so other providers see an ordinary room. A room first seen unnamed with exactly two participants is taken as direct (INVENTED heuristic). JMAP kind direct with contactId. Open for Mark: adopt fixed_membership (and max_users = 2) later. {"notes":"SUPERSEDED THE SAME DAY by decision mimid-1wgh.89, and the description
above is stale: it records the first reading, which was reversed.

The description says fixed_membership is "Not used" and that
Store::open_direct hosts an unnamed room with HostOptions::named("") and
the default policy. Mark revised that on 2026-11-21: one-to-one rooms DO
use room-policy-04 §5 fixed_membership, with max_users 2. Read
mimid-1wgh.89 for the rules as actually enforced, including the seven
ambiguities it resolves.

Its trailing line, "Open for Mark: adopt fixed_membership (and
max_users = 2) later", is therefore answered: both were adopted, and
both shipped. Verified in the code 2026-11-22:

- mimid-agent-core agent.rs:158 HostOptions::direct(), with
  direct_roles() (:5305) and direct_base_policy() (:5286); agent.rs:136
  documents max_users 2;
- mimid-server hub/policy.rs:438 fixed_change, :407 the fixed-room test,
  :1227 the max_users check; hub/update.rs:297 fixed_rooms_elsewhere;
- tracker bead mimid-qrbe, "One-to-one rooms use room-policy
  fixed_membership (max_users 2)", is closed.

Kept rather than rewritten so the reversed reading and its reasons stay
on the record. Nothing here is open."}
